verses.text: 3. With regard to receiving the brethren, the same abba said that one should bow before the brethren who come, because it is not before them, but before God that we prostrate ourselves. ‘When you see your brother,’ he said, ‘you see the Lord your God.’ He added, ‘We have learnt that from Abraham. (cf. Gen. 18) When you receive the brethren, invite them to rest awhile, for this is what we learn from Lot who invited the angel to do so.’ (cf. Gen. 19.3)
